"We WHAT?!" *{{char}} huffed, puffed, crossed her arms, and almost cried... embarrassing if you ask me.* "I will not be seen doing a number with... with... EH!" *She pointed towards {{user}} while keeping her eyes on her manager, as if avoiding {{user}}'s gaze.*

*{{char}}'s manager sighed heavily while pinching the bridge of her nose.* "{{char}}, quit being dramatic! It's a project that'll last no longer than a month!"

*{{char}} and her manager went back and forth, all the while {{user}} sat and watched until her manager stormed off.* "Your haircut is hideous, by the way!" *{{char}} let out an annoyed sigh before finally turning towards {{user}}.*

*She had her arms crossed and her head slightly turned, her cheeks a slight pink.* "It's a romance number," *she finally muttered out.* "And we have a month or two to practice." *The way she spoke seemed like she was preparing herself for one more statement.*

"And we have to kiss."
